messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Datadog ingestion delay detected for metrics + traces in us-west-2. Condition: ingest.queue_time > 120s for 5m. Auto-paging -> #incidents

oncall_kate: Taking this. I can see a number of alerts with empty graphs. First question: is this a Datadog-only issue or do we have backend errors?

cs_anya: Support: two customers reported auth timeouts and higher retry rates starting ~2500001290. Tickets 54321 and 54322. They asked if this is on our side.

obs_syd: Datadog status shows "Ingestion latency impacting traces/metrics" in US W2: https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/abcde. Several host-level metrics are missing.

sre_jordan: Confirmed gaps on Datadog dashboards. Local Prometheus exporters are still returning metrics. This looks like an observability blindspot rather than total service outage.

eng_runtime_mike: Preparing fallback: switching tracer exporter to local collector with s3 buffering on a canary. Command run: `kubectl set env deploy/gateway DD_AGENT_HOST=127.0.0.1 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway --namespace=platform` applied to 2 pods.

infra_dev_lee: Running quick synthetic: `curl -s -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.example/health` -> "200 0.12" from our probe. No obvious user-facing outage.

oncall_kate: Immediate play: 1) Silence noisy non-critical DD alerts to avoid alert storm; 2) Repoint critical SLO alerts to Prometheus exporters; 3) Notify customers with note; 4) Escalate to Datadog support and open ticket.

eng_runtime_mike: Also enabling short-duration debug logs on auth-service: `LOG_LEVEL=debug` for 15m to capture request context in case of genuine failures. Will revert after 15m.

obs_syd: I spun up a temporary Grafana dashboard from Prometheus at https://grafana.internal/d/triage/quick-slos — use this for live SLO checks instead of DD while this persists.

incident-bot: Datadog ticket created: DD-98765. Datadog acknowledged and is investigating.

cs_anya: Sent customer update at 2500001300: "Were investigating telemetry delays affecting our visibility. Engineering is using fallbacks; no confirmed service-wide outage. Next update in ~20m."

sre_jordan: Important note: if Datadog backfills metrics after recovery we will see spikes. Rely on Prometheus + synthetics for real-time decisions for at least 30m after recovery.

eng_runtime_mike: Datadog status changed to "partial recovery" at 2500001375 but they warn about backfilled data. We still have collector fallback enabled.

oncall_kate: Action checklist for oncall handoff: - Keep fallback collector enabled until 30m stable - Prometheus alerts remain primary for critical SLOs - CS to send +30m update and escalate impacted accounts - No gateway deploys for 1 hour unless required for mitigation - Revert debug logging after 15m

cs_anya: Creating CS escalation and will attach incident notes + ticket numbers.

infra_dev_lee: Note: paused non-critical deploys in infra org for 1h as precaution.

obs_syd: Monitoring both Prometheus and Datadog for divergence. If Datadog backfill creates false positives we will mute those signals until post-incident processing.

sre_jordan: I'll write the incident timeline and action items into our post-incident template. Suggested follow-ups: add automated alert fallback (Datadog -> Prometheus), test dashboard behavior when backfilled metrics appear, run tabletop for vendor-ingest failures.

oncall_kate: Handing off to night oncall at 2500001450. Summary: Datadog ingestion delay caused blind spots from ~2500001290-2500001375; fallbacks used; customers notified; monitor for backfill noise. Signing off. :white_check_mark:

cs_anya: Thanks team, I'll update customers if anything else pops up.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Datadog marked recovered at 2500001440 per their status. Active triage closed at 2500001450. Duration ~160s of active ingest disruption.
